name: folder-loop
what: rt-sync2d (folders as parent + rank; rt-sync2c REAPER check 8): two computers each drag the other's track into their own within a second, neither having seen the other's move: James puts Keys into Bass, Bee puts Bass into Keys. Each version says its folder (pk), so the studio's tree has a loop of parents; rank.tree breaks it by the newest held version, whose track goes to the top level with the other inside it, and a computer holding the same versions as a caught-up bandmate then says both tracks' folders again as the tree has them (mirror.rank_room), which fixes which one it is. Every computer, the late joiner included, must end on the same tree, a valid one: one of the two inside the other (the oracle checks they agree). On the commit before rt-sync2d's folders each computer kept the depths of whichever versions landed last: every computer ended with Keys and Bass both closing a folder that never opened.

edits.lua: local d, b, k, g = track('Drums'), track('Bass'), track('Keys'), track('Gtr'); for i, t in ipairs({ d, b, k, g }) do F.tracks[i] = t end; d.depth, b.depth, k.depth, g.depth = 0, 1, -1, 0; F.changed(); return 'Keys dragged into Bass'

local d, b, k, g = track('Drums'), track('Bass'), track('Keys'), track('Gtr'); for i, t in ipairs({ d, k, b, g }) do F.tracks[i] = t end; d.depth, k.depth, b.depth, g.depth = 0, 1, -1, 0; F.changed(); return 'Bass dragged into Keys'

checks.what: a valid tree: Drums, then Bass and Keys one inside the other, then Gtr
checks.lua: local names = {}; for _, t in ipairs(F.tracks) do local p = reaper.GetParentTrack(t); names[#names + 1] = t.name .. ' ' .. math.floor(t.depth or 0) .. (p and ' <' .. p.name or '') end; local got = table.concat(names, ','); assert(got == 'Drums 0,Bass 1,Keys -1 <Bass,Gtr 0' or got == 'Drums 0,Keys 1,Bass -1 <Keys,Gtr 0', got)
